scheme.name: New Scheme of Education and Training (NSET)
scheme.notes: Structure (papers, groups, sections) from the ICAI syllabus page https://www.icai.org/post/syllabus-nset-final. Chapters and topics extracted from the ICAI paper PDFs (links per paper in source_url and docs/syllabus-sources/ca-pdf-links.json; local copies in docs/syllabus-sources/ca/). Chapter = numbered content item of the paper; topic = its sub-item, with deeper levels written as 'Parent: item'; the Section or Part (with marks) is in the chapter's section field. ICAI does not publish marks per chapter, so chapter weights are empty. Papers published as two PDFs are merged into one paper. Paper 4 chapter 1 has no title in the source; its name was derived from its sub-items. Notes in Paper 3 saying that SA 200, 210, 230, 300, 315, 320, 500, 501, 505, 510, 530, 550, 560, 570 and 580 are covered in depth at Intermediate level and may be tested as case studies are not loaded as topics; Paper 6 is entirely case-study based and lists the seven subjects it integrates as chapters without topics. Needs editor review before publishing.
